versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

- Now requires a footage or scene description plus the length in seconds as hard inputs before generating music.
- Adds a loop-friendly duration default if the user does not specify length.
- Clarifies this Skill is not for scoring finished cuts; restricts usage to scene/footage input.
- Confirmation step now includes a commercial-clearance note for each original instrumental.
- Removes the `skill-card.md` file.
Publish the reviewed Short Video BGM Studio workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
